name: Nidalee
title: The Bestial Huntress

passive.name: Prowl

description.normalized: Starts with a rank in Aspect of the Cougar. Queen of the Jungle: Gains 10% Movement Speed in brush, increased to 30% while moving toward enemy champions. This bonus persists for 2 seconds after leaving brush. Hunter's Mark: Hitting champions or monsters with Javelin Toss or Bushwhack marks them as Hunted for 4 seconds. While an enemy is Hunted, they are revealed and Nidalee gains 10% Movement Speed, increased to 30% while moving toward the Hunted enemy. The two Movement Speed bonuses stack, with a total cap of 30.

passive.rawParsedText:
Starts with a rank in Aspect of the Cougar.

Queen of the Jungle: Gains 10% Movement Speed in brush, increased to 30% while moving toward enemy champions. This bonus persists for 2 seconds after leaving brush.

Hunter's Mark: Hitting champions or monsters with Javelin Toss or Bushwhack marks them as Hunted for 4 seconds. While an enemy is Hunted, they are revealed and Nidalee gains 10% Movement Speed, increased to 30% while moving toward the Hunted enemy.

The two Movement Speed bonuses stack, with a total cap of 30.

q.name: Javelin Toss / Takedown

description.normalized: Javelin Toss: Throws her javelin, dealing 90 / 120 / 150 / 180 (+50% AP) magic damage, increased to 225 / 300 / 375 / 450 (+125% AP) magic damage based on distance flown. Takedown: Nidalee's next attack deals 10 / 45 / 80 / 115 (+75% AD +40% AP) magic damage, increased by 1.25% per 1% of the target's missing Health. If the enemy is Hunted, deals 30% increased damage.

q.rawParsedText:
Javelin Toss: Throws her javelin, dealing 90 / 120 / 150 / 180 (+50% AP) magic damage, increased to 225 / 300 / 375 / 450 (+125% AP) magic damage based on distance flown.

Takedown: Nidalee's next attack deals 10 / 45 / 80 / 115 (+75% AD +40% AP) magic damage, increased by 1.25% per 1% of the target's missing Health. If the enemy is Hunted, deals 30% increased damage.

w.name: Bushwhack / Pounce

description.normalized: Bushwhack: Places an invisible trap for 10 seconds, When an enemy walks over it, they are revealed and dealt 10 / 20 / 30 / 40 (+4% AP) magic damage per second for 4 seconds. 4 traps may be active at once. Pounce: Pounces toward a target location, dealing 55 / 90 / 125 / 160 (+40% bonus AD +25% AP) magic damage to enemies in the area she lands. Killing an enemy in Cougar Form or using this ability on a Hunted target reduces its cooldown to 2.75 / 2.25 / 1.75 / 1.25 seconds.

e.name: Primal Surge / Swipe

description.normalized: Primal Surge: Restores 40 / 70 / 100 / 130 (+30% AP) Health to a target, increased up to 80 / 140 / 200 / 260 (+60% AP) Health based on their missing Health, and grants them 30% / 40% / 50% / 60% Attack Speed for 7 seconds. Swipe: Claws at enemies in front of her, dealing 140 (+70% bonus AD +40% AP) magic damage.

r.name: Aspect Of The Cougar

description.normalized: Passive: - While in Human Form, applying Hunted refreshes this ability's cooldown. - While in Cougar Form, Nidalee's basic ability damage scales with this ability's rank, and she gains 2 (+2.5% AP) bonus Armor and Magic Resist. Human Form (Active): Transforms into Cougar Form, gaining melee attacks and replacing her active abilities. Cougar Form (Active): Transforms into Human Form, gaining ranged attacks and replacing her active abilities.
